# Official BLAKE3 test vectors

`test_vectors.json` is copied verbatim from the official BLAKE3 repository:

- Source: <https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3/blob/master/test_vectors/test_vectors.json>
- Local reference tree: `REF/BLAKE3/test_vectors/test_vectors.json`
- Upstream project license: CC0 1.0 / Apache-2.0 (see the BLAKE3 repository)

Each case contains an input length and the expected outputs for the hash, keyed hash, and
derive-key modes. Inputs are filled with the repeating 251-byte sequence `0, 1, …, 250`.
Outputs are 131-byte extended outputs (XOF); implementations must also check that the
first 32 bytes match the default-length output.

Do not edit this file. Any additional vector must come from the same upstream source.
